remarks: Perched in West Hollywood's prestigious Shoreham Towers, this stunning front-facing, one-bedroom, two-bathroom mid-century condo delivers breathtaking, floor-to-ceiling city views and an airy open floor plan perfect for entertaining. The unit features a spacious living and dining area, a tastefully renovated kitchen, customized closet systems, and a luxurious oversized primary suite. Residents of this iconic 24-hour full-service building enjoy top-tier amenities including a doorman, valet parking, concierge, state-of-the-art fitness center, pool, and an all-inclusive HOA fee covering all utilities and cable TV.
